description: Details pursuant to condition 11(c) (Post Completion Report), of Variation of Conditions reference 25/3134 dated 28/04/2026 for Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) to vary the wording of Condition 2 (development carried out in accordance with approved drawings/documents), and add a further condition (Condition 42 - Energy Statement) to include a revised Energy Statement of Variation of Conditions reference 19/2732 dated 04 October, 2019 which allowed an increase in the proposed parameter height for Plot E to a maximum between 86.60m AOD - 92.90m AOD of Outline Planning Permission reference 18/0321 dated 28 September, 2018 for Hybrid planning permission for the redevelopment of the former Northfields Industrial Estate. (See previous application record for full description of development). This application is subject to an Environmental Statement.
